records.description: Cross-platform shared bashism detection rule set. 3 tiers (S=silent diff, E=error in ash, T1=script already asks bash). Loaded by both iOS BashismDetector and Android BashismDetector.
Cross-platform detector validation ensuring iOS/Android bashism detection parity via shared test vectors (bashism_test_vectors.json).

iOS bashism matching engine. Reads shared bashism_rules.json. Strips heredoc bodies (F1 false-positive guard), line-by-line NSRegularExpression scan, 50ms wall-clock fuse (fail-open) + 4KB per-line cap (ReDoS guard). Returns Result with needsBash/mustSwitchInterpreter/hasSilent flags.

Objective-C wrapper for the iSH usermode kernel. Key API: bootWithRootPath, executeCommand, executeCommandAndWait, sendInput, setTerminalSize, bindMountPath (read-only variant), bindUnmountPath, refreshDns, installFakefsChangeHandler, installPathTranslateHandler, installPathReverseHandler, enableCPUThrottleWithDutyCycle. ISHKernel becomes PID 1 after boot (irreversible within process).

Static shell executor with line-by-line callback API. Supports executeCommand, executeExecutable (with args/env/stdinData/fsContext variants), executeCommandSync, killProcess, killProcessGroup (SIGTERM→SIGKILL escalation). fsContext parameter enables per-session mount routing via fakefs path-translate hook.

Actor-based concurrent execution coordinator. Commands run fully concurrent (cross-session AND same-session). Each invocation forks independent /bin/sh with own pipes + fs_context token. perSessionInflight tracking for stop/preempt visibility (NOT for serialization since 2026-05-25). Static mount layer (memory/skills/shared + external), per-session routing via MinisFsRouter hook. Default timeout 300s, preempt timeout 600s.

Alpine Linux aarch64 rootfs at Documents/alpine-rootfs/. Install from alpine-rootfs.zip via custom ZIPArchive reader (deflate). Arch tag (.arch file) for mismatch detection. Pre-creates /var/minis/{attachments,offloads,workspace,skills,shared}. default_mount overlay applied each boot. Fakefs meta.db blob-encoded stat structs. PEP 668 EXTERNALLY-MANAGED marker removed for pip. reset(keepUserData:) with didResetWhileBooted flag (kernel cannot be re-booted in-process).

Overlay system: binDirs heuristic forces 0755 for iOS bundle exec-bit stripping. minis-mcp-cli lib registered as 0o444 (read-only) files + 0o555 dirs. Fakefs meta.db ensureParentDirsInMetaDB + ensureFakefsMetadata for all overlaid paths.

SQLite-backed fakefs metadata. paths table + stats table with 16-byte blob-encoded stat structs (mode + inode, little-endian). ensureParentDirsInMetaDB recursively creates ancestors. Mode 0o100000|S_IFREG for files, 0o040XXX for dirs.

Per-session mount path router using fakefs path-translate hook. Generates opaque fs_context tokens per session consulted on the hot fs path. Routes /var/minis/{session-buckets} to host persistent directories (Library/MinisChat/minis/<sid>/).

Canonical iOS tool registry. Defines 8 tools: shell_execute, file_read, file_write, file_edit, browser_use, memory_write (conditional), memory_get (conditional), read_image (conditional on imageInput). Each with AgentToolDefinition containing name/description/parameters/required/propertyOrdering.

Canonical Android tool registry. Mirrors iOS exactly: shell_execute, FileReadTool, FileWriteTool, FileEditTool, ReadImageTool (conditional), BrowserUseTool, memory_write (conditional), memory_get (conditional). Uses BrowserAction.allValues for enumValues.

Provider-agnostic agent loop abstraction. AgentToolDefinition (name/description/parameters/required/propertyOrdering), AgentParamType (.string/.integer/.boolean), AgentContentPart (.text/.toolUse/.toolResult/.imageData with linuxPath), ReasoningEcho (in-memory encrypted CoT replay), AgentMessage (role/parts/isInterrupted/reasoningContent/reasoningEcho/dbMessageId), AgentStreamEvent (.contentBlockStart/.textDelta/.toolInputDelta/.toolCallComplete/.usage/.thinkingDelta/.reasoningContent/.reasoningEcho/.done), AgentStopReason (.endTurn/.toolUse/.maxTokens/.refusal).

Multi-strategy loop prevention: (1) unknown_tool threshold=10, (2) global circuit breaker threshold=30, (3) poll no-progress (command_status, process poll/log), (4) generic repeat detection with SHA-256 hashing + volatile field stripping (timestamps/durations/request IDs). historySize=30, warningThreshold=10, criticalThreshold=20. Pre-execution check() returns warning/critical; post-execution record() for tracking.

18 browser actions: navigate, screenshot, click, type, getText, scroll, getPageInfo, executeJS, findElements, hover, getReadable, setUserAgent, setViewport, getBackbone, fetch, newTab, closeTab, listTabs, getCookies, setCookies, scrollAndCollect, waitForDomStable. UserAgentProfile: mobileSafari/desktopSafari/custom with viewport sizes (1280x800 mobile, 390x844 custom).

WKWebView-based browser tab pool (maxTabs=3 per pool). BrowserTabPoolRegistry: process-wide globalTabCap=8, cross-pool reclamation (idle-first then oldest inUse preemption). Memory warning eviction. CLI path runs singleTab mode.

Swift bridge for BrowserTabPool called from BrowserUseOffload.m. Resolves pool via ViewModelCache (live vm) or fallback pool (no cached vm). Reads mountedSessionIdSnapshot for deterministic session routing under load. Screenshots persisted to /var/minis/browser/<sid>/.

MCP (Model Context Protocol) external tool server integration. MCPServerConfig: HTTP (url+headers+oauth) or STDIO (command+args+env) transports. servers.json bind-mounted to guest /var/minis/mcp-servers/. System prompt injection (top 20 servers by createdAt). iCloud sync with per-server MCPServerItem. Semantic fingerprinting for external edit detection. refreshTools() invokes minis-mcp-cli refresh via ISHExecutionCoordinator.

Main agent ViewModel. maxAgentTurns=200, maxInLoopCompactions=3. Image budgets: kPerImageMaxBytes=5MB, kMessageImageMaxBytes=25MB, kRequestImageMaxBytes=25MB, kImageContextKeepCount=20. kMaxToolResultChars=15000. ChatMessageRole: user/assistant/compactDivider/systemInfo. AssistantBlockKind: text/thinking/shellTool/fileReadTool/fileWriteTool/fileEditTool/browserTool/readImageTool/memoryTool/info. Sync hold: postStopSyncHoldSeconds=60, defer iCloud sync during/after agent loop.

Android agent ViewModel. MAX_AGENT_TURNS=200, GLOBAL_MAX_TOKENS_CEILING=128000, COMPACT_KEEP_RECENT_USER_TURNS=3, INITIAL_VISIBLE_MESSAGE_CAP=200, LONG_SESSION_THRESHOLD=300. PREFLIGHT_NON_BLOCKING_FIELDS=tool_title. Bail-out retry + auto-retry backoff (1s,2s,4s). Tool loop detection via ToolLoopDetector.

19 offload commands: Privacy(7): apple-healthkit, apple-calendar, apple-reminders, apple-photos, apple-location, apple-homekit, apple-clipboard; Media(4): apple-speak, apple-speech, apple-player, apple-media; System(8): apple-device, apple-notification, apple-alarm, apple-open, apple-maps, apple-weather, apple-nlp, apple-vision. Permission levels: bypass/askOnce/notAllowed. extractOffloadCommand parses first shell token. 30s timeout on askOnce with CheckedContinuation.

Android offload permission system. 16 tools in registry: Privacy(5): calendar, location, clipboard, contacts, photos; Media(3): speak, media_player, speech_recognition; System(5): alarm, weather, notification, device_info; Integrations(2): a11y_cli, shizuku_cli (NOT_ALLOWED default). Supports session-scoped grants/denials. Mirrors iOS behavior.

Tri-state agent gate for android-* offload CLIs. Runs at NativeOffloadHandler entry via runBlocking bridge. enforce() returns PERMISSION_DENIED envelope (exit 126) on denial. Session scoping via MINIS_CHAT_SESSION_ID env var.

Shared utilities for all apple-* CLI tools: arg parsing (noff_find_arg, noff_has_flag, noff_get_subcommand, noff_positional_args), date parsing (ISO 8601, relative, --today), JSON envelopes (noff_json_envelope, noff_json_error with compact/quiet modes), main-thread sync dispatch (noff_dispatch_main_sync), guest stub creation (noff_ensure_guest_stub), host path resolution (noff_resolve_host_path), stdin read, ObjC exception safety (noff_try_objc). Exit codes: 0=success, 1=error, 2=invalid args, 3=auth denied, 4=not available.

Clipboard offload: subcommands get/set/clear/status. cmd_get reads UIPasteboard.hasStrings/URLs/Images, supports --image <path> to save clipboard image to host. Uses noff_dispatch_main_sync for main-thread UIKit access. JSON output via envelope utilities.

26 native offload .m files: HealthKit, Calendar, Reminders, Photos, Location, HomeKit, Clipboard, Speak, Speech, Player, Media, Device, Notification, Alarm, Open, Maps, Weather, NLP, NFC, ModelUse, Sessions, FFmpeg, Debug, Config, BrowserUse, Bluetooth. Each exposes *_offload_register() C function.

25+ Android sandbox offload handlers (.kt): Weather, Speech, Speak, Shizuku, Sessions, ScheduledTask, Player, Photos, Open, Notification, ModelUse, Location, Debug, Device, Contacts, Config, Clipboard, Calendar, BrowserUse, Alarm, Accessibility. Each implements NativeOffloadHandler interface with args/result pattern. Plus offload managers: WeatherManager, ShizukuManager/ScheduledNotificationStore, MediaPlayerManager, HealthManager, CalendarManager.
protocol LLMProvider: name, model, sendMessage(messages/systemPrompt/maxTokens/temperature) -> LLMResponse, streamMessage(...) -> AsyncThrowingStream<LLMStreamChunk, Error>.

Factory pattern dispatching to per-provider builders based on ProviderInstance.providerType. Providers: anthropic, gemini, openAI, antigravity, openRouter, openAIResponses, xAI, kimiCode. applyAzure for Azure OpenAI mode. applyCustomUserAgent injects custom UA (except OAuth/Codex). Supports apiKey/oauth/manual credentials.

Android provider factory. Routes to AnthropicProvider, GeminiProvider, OpenAIProvider (with Codex OAuth, API key, manual bearer, Azure mode). OpenRouter mapped to OpenAIProvider with custom base + extraHeaders. effectiveBaseURL normalization collapses trailing slash/v1 shapes.

~36+ models: Anthropic(7: Fable5, Opus5/4.8/4.6, Sonnet5/4.6, Haiku4.5), Gemini(6: 3.1-pro, 3-pro, 3-flash, 2.5-pro/flash/flash-lite), OpenAI(~18: gpt-5.6-sol/terra/luna, 5.5, 5.4, 5.3, 5.2, 5, 4.1, 4o, 4o-mini, o3, o3-mini, o4-mini, codex variants, gpt-image-2), Antigravity(10+: gemini-3.1-pro-high/low, gemini-3-pro-high/low/image, gemini-3-flash, claude variants), OpenRouter(4), Kimi, xAI, custom. ModelModality: text/image/pdf/audio/video I/O. ThinkingLevel: off/low/medium/high/xhigh/max/ultra. Provider capabilities: Anthropic(.vision, apiKey+oauth), Gemini(.fullMultimodal), OpenAI(.vision), Antigravity(.fullMultimodal, oauth only), OpenRouter(.vision). Context windows: Claude 1M(200K haiku), Gemini 1M, GPT-5 400K, o3 200K.
